answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> The Holy Quran Question ID: 50732 Country: India Title: Regarding Sunnah Question: Is it allowed to read the holy Quran by sitting behind a person? If it is so like in on Jumuah 1st row is completely full. So there is no option but to sit behind a person and read Quran. Please let me know. Answer ID: 50732 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 382/331/H=03/1435) It is allowable. If both the rows sit opposite to each other so that the holy Quran is not behind back side then it is better. And if it is not possible then there is no harm in following the first method. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
